name: Whispering Gardens
summary: In northeastern Tirisfal, the Whispering Gardens lie on the hillside south of the Scarlet Monastery. Early crusade defenders fought a host of the Scourge here. Now Scarlet crusaders patrol the overgrown paths, where faint voices linger.

sections.title: A Battle Echoing in the Mist
sections.body:
Before the Scarlet Crusade withdrew behind the Monastery walls, the Whispering Gardens saw fierce fighting. Undead pressed across the terraces, and countless lives were lost on both sides.

At twilight, travelers crossing the gardens report soft murmurings on the wind. Many believe these are echoes of the soldiers and priests who died defending the holy grounds.

sections.title: Crusader Outpost
sections.body:
The Scarlet Crusade keeps watch over the Whispering Gardens. Scouts, magicians, and preservers guard the trails against intruders from the lower glades.

For zealots in the nearby monastery, the overgrown steps guard their approach. They also recall the unceasing war against the undead.

faq.q: Where are the Whispering Gardens located?
aliases: how to get to whispering gardens
faq.answer: The Whispering Gardens cover the hillside just south of the Scarlet Monastery in northeastern Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why are they called the Whispering Gardens?
aliases: why is it called whispering gardens
faq.answer: The name comes from faint murmurs heard in the twilight air. They are said to be lingering voices of defenders and undead who fell in a bloody battle on the slopes.
An invading Scourge army fought the early forces that became the Scarlet Crusade. Many died before the Scourge was stopped outside the monastery.
The Scarlet Crusade controls the gardens. Its scouts, preservers, and magicians patrol the terraces and guard the southern approach to their stronghold.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, the gardens hold a fanatical Scarlet presence on Tirisfal's doorstep. Echoes of the war that doomed Lordaeron linger there.
As a priest, you can sense spiritual traces of holy defenders who died violently against the Scourge. Their souls remain bound to the winds.
